sources.name: Organized-town parcel geometry
sources.coverage: 708,382 features under 318 recognized status-coded jurisdictions. 3,809 missing STATE_IDs; code/name conflicts retained.

limitations: Municipal submissions are voluntary and irregular.

STATE_ID is not unique and includes placeholders; source records must not be silently merged.
